title: An adaptive superconvergent mixed finite element method for exactly symmetric linear elasticity based on local residual minimization
summary: We introduce an a posteriori error estimator for exactly symmetric mixed finite element discretizations of linear elasticity, based on recasting a Stenberg-type postprocessing scheme as a local residual minimization problem in a discrete dual norm. This construction yields, as a dual variable and at no additional computational cost, a Riesz representative of the associated local residual, from which we build an a posteriori error indicator.
